seedNarrative.label: Deployer redeems a ZK credential proof and becomes verified
Investor A redeems a ZK credential proof and becomes verified
Mint 5,000 ACME to KYC-verified Investor A
Investor A to deployer, 1,000 ACME: both parties verified
Investor A to Investor B, 500 ACME: reverts, recipient not verified

supersedes.//: The PF-S123 natspec pass changed ZKComplianceRegistry and KYCToken, so those two were redeployed in PF-S124 and re-verified. The previous generation stays on chain with its own history; the source that produced it is tagged verified-onchain-2026-07-31. Groth16Verifier is ABSENT from this block on purpose: PF-S123 ruled the generated verifiers stay generated-and-unmodified, so it was not redeployed and the address above IS its original one. Recorded in PF-S132 — until then this repo was the only redeployed one whose predecessor addresses were overwritten in place rather than kept.
supersedes.//seedNarrative: The seed narrative above was re-run in full against the NEW registry, because verification is granted only by redeeming a Groth16 proof and a fresh registry starts empty. These are the transactions that seeded the superseded generation; they are still on chain against the addresses in this block.
